links.comparator_used: Standard double reading with arbitration (scenario 2: AI replaces second reader)
links.outcome: Sensitivity, NPV, recall rate, PPV and arbitration rate
links.effect: Sensitivity −1.58% (P < .001), NPV −0.01% (P < .001), recall rate −0.06% (P = .04), PPV +0.03% (P < .001), arbitration rate +1.22% (P < .001)
